pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped sub-polygonal regions with diffuse, soft-edged pixel gradients. Patch size is heterogeneous, decreasing in area towards the ventral region and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light cream-colored interstitial pathways exhibiting significant pixel thickness. The network forms a continuous topological graph with clearly defined nodes at the intersection of three or more pathways.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous 1D contour along the dorsal neck characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations of the mane against the background.
